## README.md
![EarthGenome](https://data.source.coop/earthgenome/earthindexembeddings/logo.png)
# Earth Index Imagery V7

[![CC-BY-4.0 license](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC--BY--4.0-blue.svg)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
[![Sensor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sensor%F0%9F%9B%B0%EF%B8%8F-Sentinel2-blue)](https://www.esa.int/Applications/Observing_the_Earth/Copernicus/Sentinel-2)
[![Format](https://img.shields.io/badge/Format-COG%20%E2%9A%99%EF%B8%8F-purple)](https://www.cogeo.org/)

A global, cloud-free yearly mosaic of Sentinel-2 L2A imagery for **16 August 2025 to 16 August 2026**, produced by [Earth Genome](https://earthgenome.org) for [Earth Index](https://earthindex.ai). It covers 17,849 MGRS tiles between roughly 60.5°S and 70.3°N. All bands except B10 (not present in L2A) are available at their original native resolution.

This is the V7 generation and supersedes [`earthindeximagery`](https://source.coop/earthgenome/earthindeximagery). The [V7 embeddings](https://source.coop/earthgenome/earthindex-embeddings-v7) were computed from this imagery.

This data is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) international license, which, in summary, only requires attribution. It is derived from Copernicus Sentinel-2 data.

## Resources
- [Earth Index](https://earthindex.ai): explore and search this imagery in the browser
- [Earth Genome](https://earthgenome.org)
- **STAC API:** <https://stac.earthgenome.org>, collection [`sentinel2-yearly-mosaics-v7`](https://stac.earthgenome.org/collections/sentinel2-yearly-mosaics-v7). Search by place, MGRS tile or date.
- [STAC Browser](https://browser.stac.earthgenome.org/collections/sentinel2-yearly-mosaics-v7), a human-friendly interface to the same catalog
- Embeddings computed from this imagery: [`earthindex-embeddings-v7`](https://source.coop/earthgenome/earthindex-embeddings-v7)

> The `href` of each STAC asset points to Earth Genome's own S3 bucket (`s3://ei-imagery-sentinel2-prd/v7_global_2025-08-16_2026-08-16/…`). The identical files are in this repository under the same relative path.

## How it is made
Each tile is built with the [`s2mosaic`](https://github.com/DPIRD-DMA/S2Mosaic) library from [Sentinel-2 L2A Collection 1](https://element84.com/earth-search/) scenes (Earth Search STAC):
- Cloud masking with OmniCloudMask (`OCM`).
- A **medoid** composite, so each pixel is a real observation and spectral relationships between bands are preserved (not a per-band median).
- Seasonal-first scene selection with vegetation weighting (`veg_weight` 0.25). Geographic overlays adjust the selection for snow, rainforest and corn-belt regions. Up to 25 scenes are used per tile.

The exact parameters, the scenes that contributed, and the coverage are recorded on every STAC item (`composite:*` properties) and in each tile's `scene_metadata.json`.

## Naming
Each tile is a directory named by MGRS tile, then start and end date: `31TDF_2025-08-16_2026-08-16/` holds the bands for the Barcelona tile (31TDF). The directory name equals the STAC item id.

## Files in each tile directory (15)
| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `B01.tif`, `B02.tif`, `B03.tif`, `B04.tif`, `B05.tif`, `B06.tif`, `B07.tif`, `B08.tif`, `B8A.tif`, `B09.tif`, `B11.tif`, `B12.tif` | Sentinel-2 reflectance bands, UInt16, no-data 0 |
| `TCI.tif` | True-colour 8-bit RGB image |
| `PIXEL_MAP.tif` | Raster giving, per pixel, the index of the source scene used |
| `scene_metadata.json` | Decodes `PIXEL_MAP.tif`: scene id, date, cloud cover and STAC link of each source scene |

All rasters are cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs (512 × 512 blocks), on the **native 10 m grid** of the tile (10,980 × 10,980 px, one UTM zone per tile, e.g. EPSG:32631 for 31TDF). Lower-resolution bands (20 m, 60 m) are resampled to 10 m, so every band in a tile shares the same grid. The CRS of each tile is in its STAC item as `proj:code`.

> Unlike the original `earthindeximagery`, V7 is **not** reprojected to Web Mercator.

## STAC properties worth knowing
- `composite:scene_ids`, `composite:scene_dates`, `generated_from`: the Sentinel-2 L2A scenes used
- `composite:scene_count`, `composite:valid_pixels`, `composite:coverage_pct`: how much of the tile has data
- `composite:cloud_mask`, `composite:library`, `composite:veg_weight`, `composite:snow_weight`: how it was built
- `processing:software`, `processing:git_commit`: the code that produced the tile

## Example
```python
import rasterio

url = "https://data.source.coop/earthgenome/earthindeximagery-v7/31TDF_2025-08-16_2026-08-16/TCI.tif"
with rasterio.open(url) as src:
    print(src.crs, src.shape)
    window = rasterio.windows.Window(0, 0, 1024, 1024)
    rgb = src.read(window=window)
```
The same objects are readable over S3: `s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/earthgenome/earthindeximagery-v7/`.
